newsitem.title: UK: UK Japanese stocks mixed to firmer in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: UK Japanese stocks mixed to firmer in quiet trade.

text.p: Japanese stocks trading here were mixed with a firmer bias and traders reported buying interest in construction stocks.
The Nikkei 50 index was 7.02 points up at 1,453.05 by 1400 GMT.
"The market's pretty quiet but we've seen buying in stocks which have lagged the market and looked quite a bit oversold particularly the construction stocks," said one dealer.
Taisei rose four yen to 419 yen and Kajima rose 11 yen to 509 yen. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 4026
